# T16 — Gap analysis (retrospective, 2026-11-23)

## Baseline

Before T16: procedure knowledge lived in documents; there was no typed, versioned ingestion, no
human publication gate on the drafting job, and no bound PDDL execution from an ingested source.

## Target

A SOP, an OWL/Turtle file or a BPMN/Visio/draw.io diagram becomes a typed draft through the product's
own actions; a human gate publishes it; a re-ingest versions it while the published row stays stable;
a bound job runs its PDDL steps; an unreviewed source never binds.

## Gaps and work packages

| Gap | Work package (accepted) |
|---|---|
| SOP sources not ingested | 1 — SOP intake as a governed asset |
| RDF/OWL not bound to procedures | 2 — knowledge pack bound by `knowledge_pack_ref` |
| Process documents not converted | 3 — BPMN, Visio and draw.io to PDDL drafts |
| Drafting could publish | 4 — source review and human publication gates |
| Re-ingest forked the row | 5 — re-ingest versioning |
| Unreviewed sources could bind | 6 — bound job runs the PDDL steps |

Residual gap: live-cluster fault injection is T7's live proof, recorded separately; T16's gate is
the executed test set, not a probe.
title: T16 — Gap analysis (retrospective, 2026-11-23)
